summary: Confirmed all three unique-research-proposal fluency comparisons: Intensive versus Low, Medium versus Low, and Intensive versus Medium. Read the complete markdown conversion, including references and Appendices A-F. Independently extracted the cited PDF pages 13 and 14 and checked the methods and relevant appendices against the PDF. Table 4 prints participant-level hourly means (SDs) of 1.58 (0.77), 1.88 (1.20), and 2.19 (1.11) for Intensive, Medium, and Low, respectively. Section 5.3.1 prints 51 analyzed participants, with 17 per condition; all recorded arm counts match. No pair-specific total is printed. The question, construct, measure, unit, direction, AI availability, timing, between-person design, and AI-configuration comparison codes are supported. Participant-level SDs and counts support participant-based uncertainty under codebook section 10; no separately printed pairwise SE or test is inferred. The three-arm omnibus test is correctly not assigned to any pairwise record. No additional eligible outcome or contrast was identified. Self-reported creativity support, workload, contribution, and ownership are excluded correctly, as are process-action counts, qualitative accounts, and non-randomized development evaluations. Generate_seed_ideas is not established as a count of distinct participant outputs: the methods and Table 4 describe function-use frequencies, while Appendix D illustrates multiple AI seed ideas from one generation step. Its documented exclusion is therefore supported. Appendix F reports pairwise tests only for prompting and improvement-selection actions, not for unique-proposal fluency.
